verdict.rationale: No documented Stripe Identity feature lets a developer reuse a prior passed verification session across future sessions/products; verification_sessions are created fresh each time (stripe-identity-docs-5, stripe-identity-docs-13), and the only reuse-related guidance found is about blocking fraudulent documents (stripe-identity-docs-11) or limiting repeat verification attempts (stripe-identity-docs-19), not recognizing/skipping re-verification for an already-verified user.
